sign.description: The header band, the main action of each group (AI 相片辨識, 影相分析, 用相片 AI 辨識, retry), the raised camera tab, the current-tab bar, the analysis scan line, alert and invalid frames, error text, and the dashed AI 起草 chip. Also the browser theme colour. It frames and acts; it is never a reading surface.

sign-deep.description: Hover and current states of every red control; destructive text (刪除, the delete icon) and the invalid-correction alert on the meal board.

sign-tint.description: Small secondary text set on red (sublabels such as 相片起草) and the disabled account button.

yolk.description: The price boards, the KcalCue wordmark on red, text selection, the per-dish kcal tag in the editor, yolk-on-ink numerals (item count, dish index, principle pill, demo chip), the syncing status dot and the photo status badge.

yolk-soft.description: The macro cells under each price board, provisional notices (coverage, inline warnings, mode banner, demo note) and hover on choice controls.

keep.description: The save action (儲存餐點 in the save bar) and the 已保存 chip. Nothing else.

steel.description: The page ground, the installed-app background, disabled fields and the scrollbar track.

steel-2.description: Tray strips under placards (meal rows, the editor's food list), ghost-button hover, disabled buttons and the analysis photo well.

steel-3.description: Tray edges, hairlines between list rows and disabled button frames.

steel-4.description: Dashed outlines of empty slots, disabled field frames, the data-source hairline and the scrollbar thumb. Lines only, never text (2.6:1 on the counter).

foam.description: Placards, cards, resting buttons, chips, notices, the save bar and the bottom nav.

white.description: Text fields, the hover lift of foam controls, and text on red and green.

ink.description: Every frame and rule, primary text, the rail fill, the hatch, the status strip and the focus outline.

ink-2.description: Secondary text, rail ticks, times and dates.

ink-3.description: Tertiary text, placeholders, resting nav labels and subtitle lines.

wordmark.purpose: KcalCue in Yolk on the red band.

headline.purpose: Screen titles (今日飲食, 歷史記錄, 記低新一餐); 24px for the editor title; 22px for analysing, recovery and the photo hero.

title.purpose: Section and day headings (食物明細, 主要不確定因素, History dates); 18px for card headings; 17px for tray titles (早餐, 午餐, 晚餐, 小食) over a 3px ink rule.

placard-name.purpose: Dish names on placards and in the dish-name field.

figure.purpose: Macro values, the meal count and the meal-board figure line; the day board's kcal unit is 22px in 600 and the editor's kcal tag 22px in 700.

figure-sm.purpose: Kcal ranges on placards and in tray meta lines.

numeric-meta.purpose: Times and the Today date (16px for History day stamps); 13px for rail ticks; 18px inside date, time and number fields (20px for portions).

body.purpose: Running text; 15px in Ink 2 for secondary copy inside cards.

label.purpose: Board and cell labels, chip text and form labels.

label-sm.purpose: Field captions, nav labels and small tags (已保存, 備註).

button.purpose: Button labels; 16px in the save bar and quick actions, 17px on large buttons.

rings.name: alert-ring
rings.purpose: Doubles the 2px red frame of alert notices and invalid fields. A border, never depth.

rings.name: status-dot-ring
rings.purpose: Rings the 9px status dot on the ink strip.

rings.name: offline-dot-ring
rings.purpose: The hollow status dot while offline.

patterns.name: hatch
patterns.purpose: Unknown or insufficient data: a 20×10px swatch in a 1.5px ink frame inline, or the whole rail when a total is unknown.

literals.purpose: Paper-white text and rings on the ink status strip (not yet a token).
Frame of the 帳戶 outline button on the red band (0.45 when disabled).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons and the camera tab nudge 1px down while pressed.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Hover fills: red to Roast Red, Foam to White, ghost to Tray Steel.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Details chevrons turn from -45° to 45° when opened.

motion.name: placard-in
motion.value: 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; translateY(10px) to none; 45ms stagger, capped at 180ms
motion.purpose: Food editor placards rise into place when a draft arrives.

motion.name: scan
motion.purpose: The 5px Signboard Red scan line sweeps the photo while analysing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms, one iteration
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: narrow-phone (max-width)
breakpoints.purpose: Date takes its own row; day-board figure 52px; upload button icons hidden.

breakpoints.name: phone (max-width)
breakpoints.purpose: 12px gutter; 14px card padding; tagline hidden; entry cards stack.

breakpoints.name: wide (min-width)
breakpoints.purpose: 24px gutter; 20px section gaps; three-column how-to steps.

breakpoints.name: tray-wall (min-width)
breakpoints.purpose: Today's four trays form a 2×2 wall; History meal rows pair up.

breakpoints.name: result-split (min-width)
breakpoints.purpose: Result main column plus a 272px sticky sidebar.

breakpoints.name: food-placard (container min-width)
breakpoints.purpose: Portion fields share one row inside a food placard.

narrative.northStar: 兩餸飯餸牌: The Two-Dish Rice Counter
narrative.overview:
Every meal is a tray of picked dishes, laid out the way a Hong Kong two-dish-rice (兩餸飯) shop shows its food: a signboard-red band overhead, a stainless counter below, each dish on its own ink-framed placard, and the total written up on a yolk price board. The AI lays the dishes out as placards, the eater checks each one, and the honest range sits on the board. Surfaces are printed, not glassy: heavy ink frames, near-square corners, condensed numerals readable across a café table, and no shadow anywhere.

Density is counter-dense rather than dashboard-dense. Placards pack edge to edge in their trays, totals are large and drawn to scale, and everything else stays quiet foam and steel. State is carried by form before colour: a dashed line is a draft still to be checked, a solid line is saved, a 45° ink hatch is unknown, and an empty slot is a dashed grey outline. Each colour has one job: red is the shop's sign and its main action, yolk carries the headline total, green belongs only to saving.

AI photo recognition is the primary entry and wears the red; manual logging sits beside it in foam, secondary but always available. The world refuses the calorie-app default: no calorie ring counting down a goal, no pastel macro donuts, no cream-and-sage wellness cards. It replaces the warm-white, deep-green and coral palette that DECISIONS.md §9 still describes; that section's fixed result order still binds.

Open decisions: the app icon (public/icon.svg and its PNG versions, a deep-green #173f35 tile with cream and orange) predates this world and has not been confirmed by James, so it was deliberately left untouched and stays that way until he chooses keep or redraw. The subtitle lines under headings stay as written until James decides whether to remove them.
keyCharacteristics: Signboard-red band and primary action over a stainless-steel ground.
Foam-white placards in 2–3px ink frames with 3–4px corners.
Yolk price boards with range rails drawn from 0 to at least 1500 kcal.
Barlow Condensed for figures; the system Hei stack for names and sentences.
State by form: dashed is draft, solid is saved, hatched is unknown.
Green only for save and saved; no shadows anywhere.

rules.name: The Keep-Green Rule
rules.body: Green belongs only to saving and saved: the 儲存餐點 button, the 已保存 chip and the synced dot. A screen with nothing saved or being saved shows no green.

rules.name: The Signboard Rule
rules.body: Red is the shop's sign and the one main action per group. It frames and acts (band, primary buttons, camera tab, current tab, error frames); it never becomes a reading surface.

rules.name: The Price-Board Rule
rules.body: A screen's headline total (the day on Today and History, the meal on the result screen) sits on a Yolk board in Counter Ink, with its range rail and its macros on Soft Yolk beneath. Per-meal and per-dish ranges stay small on their trays and placards.

rules.name: The Figures-In-Barlow Rule
rules.body: A number that stands as a value (kcal, grams, counts, times, dates, ticks, numeric inputs) is set in Barlow Condensed; a number inside a Chinese sentence stays in Hei with its sentence.

rules.name: The Edge-to-Edge Rule
rules.body: Placards pack edge to edge: auto-fit columns with an 8px gap, at least 144px wide in trays and 272px in the food editor, so a tray fills its width however many dishes it holds.

rules.name: The One-Scale Rule
rules.body: Every kcal range is drawn to scale on a rail that starts at 0 and reaches at least 1500 kcal, so ordinary meals and days share one scale. A range that runs past 1500 extends its own rail to the next 500 kcal (ticks every 500 up to 2000, then every 1000).

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, glows, blurs or offset shadows, at rest or on hover. box-shadow appears only as a zero-offset, zero-blur ring that thickens a frame or rings the status dot.

rules.name: The Form-Is-State Rule
rules.body: State is carried by form before colour. Dashed Counter Ink marks a draft or an AI-origin item still to be checked: food placards in the editor, the unsaved-draft banner, the AI 分析結果 chip, original-AI details, low-confidence badges and panels, provisional Soft Yolk notices and the 新增食物 slot (the editor's AI 起草 chip draws the same dash in Signboard Red). Solid ink is the resting frame: saved placards and trays on Today and History, and the interface's own boards, cards, fields and buttons. The ink hatch marks unknown or insufficient data. Dashed Rivet Grey marks an empty slot.

dos: Do carry state by form: dashed ink for drafts and AI-origin items, solid ink once saved, the 45° ink hatch for unknown or insufficient data, dashed Rivet Grey for empty slots.
Do lead entry points with the AI photo action in Signboard Red and keep a Foam White manual option on the same surface.
Do set figures that stand as values in Barlow Condensed (700 for amounts, 600 for times, dates and ticks) and names and sentences in the Hei stack.
Do draw every kcal range to scale on a rail from 0 to at least 1500 kcal, ink fill at its true position, hatched when the total is unknown.
Do frame placards, cards, fields and buttons in Counter Ink (2px; 3px for boards, entry buttons, the save bar and the nav rule) with 3px or 4px corners.
Do pack placards edge to edge with auto-fit columns and an 8px gap (144px minimum in trays, 272px in the food editor).
Do keep the result order kcal range → confidence → breakdown → uncertainty → correction controls.
Do keep the save bar sticky above the nav only while the draft has foods, static otherwise.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and the 3px ink focus outline (Yolk on the red band).
Do keep the structural hooks, aria-labels and accessible names through every restyle.
donts: Don't use green for anything but saving and saved.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or blur for depth; separate with frames, tone and overlap.
Don't show an unknown as zero, a blank or an empty rail; hatch it and say so.
Don't reach for the calorie-app default: no calorie ring counting down a goal, no pastel macro donuts, no cream-and-sage wellness cards.
Don't change UI copy without James's approval; a restyle keeps every string.
Don't add new subtitle lines under headings on new surfaces; the existing ones are carried copy awaiting James's decision.
Don't round frames past 4px; circles are only for dots and the camera.
Don't let Signboard Red fill a reading surface.
Don't recolour, redraw or replace the app icon (public/icon.svg and its PNGs) until James confirms keep or redraw.
